thread:
alex: Heads-up — hourly_usage rollups haven't moved since 2026-03-17 04:00 UTC (~5h). Several customers reporting empty charts on the console. Quick check: 
```sql
SELECT max(hour) FROM hourly_usage;
-- 2026-03-17 04:00:00
```
maria: Which cluster/tenant? can you paste the query + any error logs? I'll check consumer groups.
alex: prod-us-east, affected tenants look broad (multiple orgs). sample query for tenant=acme_inc: 
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM hourly_usage WHERE tenant_id='acme_inc' AND hour >= '2026-03-17'::date;
-- 0 rows
```
lina: @maria i'm oncall — checked kafka consumer group `usage-ingest` a few mins ago: 
```text
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server pkc-...:9092 --describe --group usage-ingest
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
usage-events    0          1248100         2480000         1231900
usage-events    1          1247000         2481000         1234000
```
lina: so ~1.2M messages backlog across partitions. :eyes:
ingestor-bot: CDC connector `wal2json-consumer-prod` restarted automatically at 2026-03-17T04:12:07Z due to liveness probe failure (oom). Refer to connector logs.
sam: if the connector restarted and stays down, CDC won't publish events. can someone check postgres replication slot + connector status?
leo: quick psql check: 
```bash
$ psql -h pg-prod -c "SELECT slot_name, active, restart_lsn FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE slot_type='logical';"
 slot_name     | active | restart_lsn
----------------+--------+-------------
 usage_slot     | f      | 0/16A3C80
```
leo: slot inactive = connector not attached, so events are not being streamed but are still in WAL -> backlog builds up.
maria: thanks. two options: 1) attach connector (if it survives OOM, tune JVM/heap) 2) run backfill job to rebuild hourly rollups from raw events to catch up quickly. backfill is safe but will temporarily increase load. estimate ~2.5 hours for current backlog on a medium backfill worker.
alex: any risk to production API or billing while backfilling? will this re-ingest duplicate events into metrics?
leo: backfill reads raw events and writes rollups idempotently using upsert by (tenant,hour). shouldn't affect API traffic. small increase in DB writes; monitor pg write iops.
maria: runbook: https://wiki.redwood-inference/internal/runbooks/analytics-backfill. command to kick a targeted backfill for the 04:00-09:00 window: 
```bash
$ /ops/run-jobs backfill-hourly --start 2026-03-17T04:00Z --end 2026-03-17T09:00Z --shards 0..7 --priority high --owner @lina
```
ops-bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=bf-20260317-199876. Track progress at https://jobs.redwood-inference/jobs/bf-20260317-199876
lina: i'm going to trigger the targeted backfill now. will also attempt a connector restart with increased heap after. :thumbsup:
lina: started backfill job `bf-20260317-199876` at 2026-03-17T05:40:12Z. Monitoring metrics, will post updates.
alex: thanks — i'll ping impacted customers with ETA ~3h and note we're running a backfill.
maria: FYI root cause looks like config rollout to connector triggered transient memory spike -> liveness restart. need to pin connector JVM params. I'll open a follow-up ticket.
lina: first progress update: job is ~20% through, write QPS at expected levels, no noticeable API impact.
leo: connector restart completed at 2026-03-17T06:05:00Z and reattached to slot. consumer lag is decreasing.
alex: good sign — hourly_usage now showing data up to 08:00 UTC. dashboards for affected tenants starting to repopulate. I'll keep monitoring until fully caught up.
maria: follow-up action items: 1) increase connector heap / enable steady-state cgroup limits 2) add alert on replication slot inactive >5m 3) postmortem + ops ticket.
lina: closing loop in support thread once fully backfilled. :white_check_mark:
